attitude_disturbance.boundary: illustrative single-axis linear model; no claim that all spacecraft torques are constant or that PD rejects constant torque without offset

newton.boundary: inertial coordinate, linear spring and viscous damping, displacement from equilibrium

similar_first_order.thermal: C_th DeltaT_dot+DeltaT/R_th=P; C_th=2 J/K, R_th=0.5 K/W, P=2 W
similar_first_order.electrical: C V_dot+V/R=I; C=2 F, R=0.5 ohm, I=2 A
similar_first_order.scaledCoordinates: DeltaT/(1 K), V/(1 V), t/(1 s)
similar_first_order.boundary: linear lumped parameters and matched scaled inputs; physical temperature and voltage remain different quantities

isomorphic_second_order.boundary: state map requires matching derivative state and forcing, not merely equal pole locations

loading.loadedPotentiometer: total R=1 ohm, load=1 ohm, lower fraction alpha=0.5: output/input=0.4; unloaded=0.5
loading.boundary: buffer must isolate loading; multiplying isolated component transfers requires appropriate ports

sensor.calibration: divide voltage by 2 V/rad; calibrated DC gain is 1 but lag remains
sensor.boundary: no saturation, noise or calibration drift included; measured signal must share units with reference before subtraction
